title: NuaSense station reading
description: One reading from a weather station, in the units NuaSense stores. This is what the JSON ingest endpoint (POST /api/nuasense/v1/ingest/readings) accepts per row and what every console upload (Ecowitt, Ambient, Wunderground format) is converted into.

time.description: When the reading was taken, RFC 3339, UTC preferred. Not older than 90 days.

temperature.description: Air temperature, °C, in a radiation shield at ~2 m.

pressure.description: Station pressure, hPa — absolute, not reduced to sea level.

light.description: Illuminance, lux. Global radiation in W/m² × ~126.7.

wind_speed.description: Mean wind speed over the interval, m/s.

wind_gusts.description: Peak gust over the interval, m/s.

wind_direction.description: Direction the wind comes from, degrees clockwise from north.

rain_mm.description: Rain since the previous reading, mm. Console uploads carry running counters; NuaSense turns them into this.

rain_pulses.description: Legacy: tipping-bucket pulses since the previous reading, summed as 1 pulse = 1 mm. Prefer rain_mm.
